parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT substr_struct.canonical_smiles, substr_mol.pref_name AS substrate_compound_name, parent_mol.pref_name AS parent_compound_name, met.met_conversion, met.pathway_key, met.organism, met.enzyme_name FROM metabolism met JOIN compound_records substr_rec ON met.substrate_record_id = substr_rec.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary substr_mol ON substr_rec.molregno = substr_mol.molregno JOIN compound_structures substr_struct ON substr_mol.molregno = substr_struct.molregno JOIN compound_records parent_rec ON met.drug_record_id = parent_rec.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary parent_mol ON parent_rec.molregno = parent_mol.molregno WHERE met.enzyme_name = 'CYP2B6' ORDER BY substr_struct.canonical_smiles, substr_mol.pref_name, parent_mol.pref_name, met.met_conversion, met.pathway_key, met.organism, met.enzyme_name LIMIT 200
